elements.description: Generated images as a grid of variations: regenerate one, upscale, compare two, download, alt text for each.

properties.name: prompt
properties.description: The prompt the images came from, shown under the heading

properties.name: columns
properties.description: Tiles per row (fewer when there are fewer tiles)

properties.name: actions
properties.description: Which actions a done tile offers

properties.name: compare
properties.description: The two tile ids side by side, or null for the grid

properties.name: split
properties.description: Where the compare divider is: 0–100, percent from the left

properties.name: openable
properties.description: Done tiles open: clicking the image, or Space or O on the tile, fires tc-open (for a viewer or a detail pane)

properties.name: fill
properties.description: Grow to the container's width instead of stopping at 560px

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-open
events.description: A done tile was opened (its image clicked, or Space or O on the tile) – only when `openable` is set. Detail: ImageGridTileEvent ({ tile, index })

events.name: tc-regenerate
events.description: Regenerate (or Try again) on a tile; the app answers by updating it. Detail: ImageGridTileEvent ({ tile, index })

events.name: tc-upscale
events.description: Upscale on a done tile; the app answers by updating it. Detail: ImageGridTileEvent ({ tile, index })

events.name: tc-download
events.description: Download on a done tile. Cancelable: unless prevented, the image is saved. Detail: ImageGridTileEvent ({ tile, index })

events.name: tc-tiles-change
events.description: An alt text was edited. Cancelable. Detail: ImageGridTilesChange ({ tiles })

events.name: tc-compare-change
events.description: Two tiles go side by side, or the comparison closes. Cancelable. Detail: ImageGridCompareChange ({ compare })

events.name: tc-split-change
events.description: The compare divider moved. Cancelable. Detail: ImageGridSplitChange ({ split })

props.name: title
props.description: Names the grid – the heading over the images

props.name: prompt
props.description: The prompt the images came from, shown under the title

props.name: tiles
props.description: The images. Controlled when defined – pass back what onTilesChange reports (alt-text edits)

props.name: defaultTiles
props.description: Starting images when uncontrolled

props.name: onTilesChange
props.description: An alt text was edited: the whole list with the change

props.name: compare
props.description: The two tile ids side by side, or null for the grid. Controlled when defined

props.name: defaultCompare
props.description: The compared pair at first when uncontrolled – null, the grid, by default

props.name: onCompareChange
props.description: Two tiles went side by side, or the comparison closed (null)

props.name: split
props.description: Where the compare divider is, 0–100. Controlled when defined

props.name: defaultSplit
props.description: Where the divider starts when uncontrolled – 50 by default

props.name: onSplitChange
props.description: The compare divider moved: its new place, 0–100

props.name: onOpen
props.description: A done tile was opened – its image clicked, or Space or O on it. Setting it makes the tiles openable

props.name: onRegenerate
props.description: Regenerate (or Try again) on a tile – answer by updating the tile: pending, then done with the new src

props.name: onUpscale
props.description: Upscale on a tile – answer by updating the tile

props.name: onDownload
props.type: (tile: ImageGridTile, index: number, event: Event) => void
props.description: Download on a tile; the image is saved unless you call event.preventDefault()

changelog: `tc-image-grid` – generated images as a grid: pending, done and failed tiles, regenerate, upscale, download (saves by default), compare two with a keyboard slider, and required, editable alt text. WAI-ARIA grid.

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: Container size queries
features.why: Components adapt to the width they're given, not the window's.

features.name: inert
features.why: Closed and leaving parts are out of the tab order and hidden from screen readers.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.

features.name: backdrop-filter
features.without: What's behind a translucent surface isn't blurred; the surface keeps its fill.
